name: Whisparr Sync
summary: Keeps Cove in step with the Whisparr instance you configure, calling out to it with an API key you supply and Cove holds server-side. Connect to either Whisparr generation, test the connection, and register Cove's import callback so what Whisparr imports reaches your library. Monitor and unmonitor a studio or a performer from its own Cove page, or a whole selection at once, without ever asking Whisparr to search. One endpoint answers anonymously - the import callback Whisparr posts to - and it is authenticated by a secret this extension mints rather than by a Cove permission; every other endpoint requires one.
